mentioned.quote: Offensive cyberoperations. A model’s ability to provide significant capability uplift to an actor seeking to carry out highly disruptive or destructive cyberattacks, including on critical infrastructure.

threshold.quote: The model provides meaningful uplift to a low-to-medium skilled actor’s ability to create and conduct highly disruptive or destructive cyber-attacks, including on critical infrastructure

response.quote: Models posing high-risk on one or more tracked capability will be subject to security measures protective against most cybercrime groups and insider threats.
response.note: Framework-wide for each tracked capability; named measures (restricted access, defense in depth, security red teaming) follow on p.8; also further review and mitigations before deployment (p.7). Pause commitment p.9.

acc_decider.quote: The Executive Officers (or their delegates) will make the final decision on whether to approve the recommendation for secure and trustworthy deployment.

acc_external.note: External involvement is hedged: 'As appropriate, evaluations involve qualified and expert external actors' (p.7), red teaming 'using third parties where appropriate' (p.8), 'external expertise where appropriate' (p.9); board oversight and internal audit (p.10) are internal; public sharing is not review.

acc_unmet.quote: If, during the implementation of this framework, we identify a risk we cannot sufficiently mitigate, we will pause development and deployment until the point at which mitigation practices evolve to meet the risk.
